verdict.rationale: The evidence shows TrueLayer splitting access into distinct products, which implies some product-level scoping. The Data API exposes separate identity, accounts, transactions and balance data. The Verification API checks account ownership only against accounts the user consented to, a narrower purpose than full data access. Nothing in the pack documents selectable OAuth scopes or explicit data-minimization controls. Missing for 10: documented per-scope selection in the consent/auth flow, explicit data-minimization guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration of granular consent.
